user.title: Connect to Vurio
user.description: Make an API token in Vurio under Settings → API tokens, with live:view, events:read and recordings:read — and cameras:manage to switch cameras from here.

data_description.url: Where Vurio answers, for example http://192.168.1.10:8099.

reauth_confirm.title: Vurio needs a new token
reauth_confirm.description: The API token for {url} was refused. Make a new one in Vurio and enter it here.

error.cannot_connect: Vurio could not be reached at that address.
error.missing_permission: The token needs at least live:view.

abort.already_configured: This Vurio installation is already added.
